newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Tessenderlo to buy CGE unit.
newsitem.headline: Tessenderlo to buy CGE unit.

text.p: Belgian chemicals group Tessenderlo said on Monday it was planning to buy 100 percent of French Seperef SA, a subdidiary of French Compagnie Generale des Eaux (CGE).
"The Tessenderlo group and CGE are in talks regarding the transfer of 100 percent of the shares of Seperef SA, subsidiary of CGE, to the Tessenderlo group," the Belgian company said in a statement.
Seperef is a producer of plastic pipes based north of Lyon.
Tessenderlo said it was already active on the French market through its 100 percent subsidiary Sotra Industries, based near Hesdin in the north of France.
"There are a lot of synergies between Sotra and Seperef," it said.
It said Seperef has an annual turnover of 280 million French francs and workforce of about 180.
"The acquisition of Seperef by the Tessenderlo group is aimed at strengthening its Plastics Transformation Division.
